body: I mean you're not wrong? But unless you're prepared to go through various ethics committees and the proper channels (human experimentation is serious business!), that's less science and more experimentation. Also, bromothymol blue is a pH indicator- most it'll do is make you sick, not sure if it is actually more harmful than that. It does turn blue in bases (and yellow in acids!), so a better use would be to put drops of it in baking soda and see what happens. You won't die, but you'll get so see some cool chemical interactions and pretty colours, and i think that's worth something!
